passHistory.reason: Replaced primitive brain folds, balloon-like lungs and oval stomach with sculpted cortical grooves, tapered lobes, a four-chamber myocardial volume and a hollow J-shaped stomach.
Aligned hand anatomy with the source paws and recessed superficial tissues beneath the exterior envelope.
Used proportional skin inset and disabled even-thickness amplification at narrow ear tips; final skin envelope is smooth and contained.
Preserved single primitive materials so intact organ surfaces render alongside stencil caps; retained intended camera direction through layout resize.
Placed the panel after the viewer on mobile, eliminated horizontal overflow, and made selected names visible above the viewer.

Named coverage, manifold volumes, texture decoding, metadata, transfer and triangle budgets, interactive cuts, exploded selection, desktop/mobile controls and production checks pass. The anatomy is an imagined study with simplified major structures.
